_: guardians on Pincredibles' 'Guardians of the Galaxy' 2.1.1 (cGameName gotg_2020, VPUniverse),
a scripted tribute with PinUP Player: vpxshadow.py keeps its script as a shadow game
and hands the ball to the real game. The table is a Premium/LE playfield: both
spinners (Ronan, Drax), the Orb behind its drop target, Rocket's kicker, Groot's
mouth and lock - so the LE is the card it matches (`preferred`); the same table on a Pro card map is the
fallback when only a Pro card is there: its spinners have no switch.
Switches by NAME through this card's switch_list.txt; coils [node, index] from
device_xy.txt (group 72 = node 8, 73 = node 9). Shot names: Yondu = LEFT LANE,
Ronan = LEFT ORBIT, Rocket = Rocket's kicker (the machine's KICKBACK coil and opto,
node 9), Nebula = LEFT RAMP, Groot, Broker = ORB, Gamora = RIGHT RAMP,
Drax = RIGHT ORBIT, Star-Lord = RIGHT SCOOP.
Mechs in extra_vbs: Groot's trough is a 4-switch ball stack swapped in for the
generated saucer on the first slow update; his mouth stays open; the Orb's drop
target follows CENTER DROP TARGET-UP/DOWN and its inside target stands back up.
PuPInit is quieted and PadNoPuP always stands in for PinUP Player (the table's
PuPInit calls puplayer.getroot, which the stub lacks).
AddScore is quieted (PAD-976): the machine keeps the score, and the table's own
game never starts, so its PlayersPlayingGame stays 0 and AddScore's
UpdateNumberPlayers2 died on ScoreTable(-1, ...) the first time a sub the bridge
leaves the table (tgAntiqueShop_Dropped, GrootMouth_Hit) scored. Those two are
the table's own rules besides and are quieted with it.
neuter: ball creation and kicks, the table's own `dim bsTrough` (the bridge Dims
it), and every B2S Controller call (they would reach PAD.Controller and steal
its ChangedLamps).

extra_vbs:
'---- PAD (map extra_vbs): GOTG's mechs, driven by the machine's coils
Sub PadRightScoop(e)
	If e Then
		bsLeftScoop.SolOut True
		LeftScoopK.IsDropped = 0
		vpmTimer.AddTimer 100, "LeftScoopK.IsDropped = 1 '"
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadOrbDropUp(e)
	If e Then
		OrbTarget1.IsDropped = False
		Controller.Switch(1047) = False
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadOrbDropDown(e)
	If e Then
		OrbTarget1.IsDropped = True
		Controller.Switch(1047) = True
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadOrbitGates(e)
	LoopGateLeft.Open = e
	Gate002.Open = e
End Sub

' Groot's mouth stays open (the machine's jaw is a node-board motor the table
' cannot follow) and his trough holds up to four balls on GROOT TROUGH 1..4;
' the inside-the-Orb target stands back up (the machine's is a standup); the
' Orb's blocking wall stays out of the way. Run from vpmTimer's slow updates.
Class PadGotgMechs
	Private mSwapped, mOrbDown
	Private Sub Class_Initialize
		mSwapped = False
		mOrbDown = 0
	End Sub
	Public Sub Reset
	End Sub
	Public Sub Update
		If Not mSwapped Then
			If IsObject(bsGrootKicker) Then
				Set bsGrootKicker = PadGrootStack
				mSwapped = True
			End If
		End If
		If GrootMouth.Collidable Then
			GrootMouth.Collidable = False
			GrootMouth.Z = -30
		End If
		If OrbTarget1Disabled.Collidable Then
			OrbTarget1Disabled.Collidable = False
		End If
		If OrbTarget2.IsDropped Then
			mOrbDown = mOrbDown + 1
			If mOrbDown > 15 Then
				OrbTarget2.IsDropped = False
				mOrbDown = 0
			End If
		Else
			mOrbDown = 0
		End If
	End Sub
End Class
Dim PadGrootStack : Set PadGrootStack = New cvpmBallStack
PadGrootStack.InitSw 0, 1071, 1072, 1073, 1074, 0, 0, 0
PadGrootStack.InitKick GrootKicker, 180, 20
PadGrootStack.IsTrough = False
Dim PadMechs : Set PadMechs = New PadGotgMechs
vpmTimer.EnableUpdate PadMechs, False, True

' PinUP Player is the shadow game's display; the machine's LCD is the real one
Set PuPlayer = New PadNoPuP

' The table's own init ends in its EndOfGame: GiOff (PF_GiOFF, a dark overlay
' over the whole playfield, and every plastic on its GI-off image) and its
' attract show on the dome flashers (the four red domes and the hadron dome,
' HadronFlash). Only its own game start (ResetForNewGame) undoes them, and
' that game never starts behind the machine (PAD-1093). The machine has no
' flashers for the domes (its coil list has none), so they rest; the GI's look
' follows the machine's GI strings (PadGotgGi, the map's lamp_calls).
Dim PadGiBottom, PadGiTop, PadGiLit, PadGiSeen
PadGiSeen = False
PadGiBottom = 0 : PadGiTop = 0 : PadGiLit = 2   ' 2: not yet set (True is -1 in VBScript)
Sub PadGotgLookOff
	bFlash1Enabled = False : bFlash2Enabled = False
	bFlash3Enabled = False : bFlash4Enabled = False
	bFlash4FastEnabled = False
	tmrHadronLightFlash.Enabled = False
	GiOn
	PadGiLit = True
	PadGotgBulbsOff
End Sub
' Four bulbs by the right ramp (Lampz 1-4: the table's UPGRADE, MODE
' SELECT, MYSTERY and EXTRA BALL) are its own rules' indicators; their
' blink timers are on from the editor, so they blinked all game behind
' the machine, which has no such lamps (PAD-1099). They rest.
Sub PadGotgBulbsOff
	On Error Resume Next
	flshUpgrade.TimerEnabled = False : flshModeSelect.TimerEnabled = False
	flshMystery.TimerEnabled = False : flshExtraBall.TimerEnabled = False
	Dim n : For n = 1 To 4 : Lampz.SetLamp n, False : Next
End Sub
Sub PadGotgGi(n, v)
	Dim lit
	If n = 0 Then
		PadGiBottom = v
	Else
		PadGiTop = v
	End If
	lit = (PadGiBottom <> 0) Or (PadGiTop <> 0)
	PadGotgGiLook lit
End Sub
Sub PadGotgGiLook(lit)
	' the machine's GI reads off until the game first lights it (a run reads
	' its lamps a few seconds into attract): the look stays on till then
	If lit Then PadGiSeen = True
	If Not PadGiSeen Then Exit Sub
	If lit = PadGiLit Then Exit Sub
	PadGiLit = lit
	If lit Then
		GiOn
	Else
		GiOff
	End If
	If IsObject(PadLampState) Then PadReassertLamps   ' the bulbs are the machine's
End Sub

lamps._: table light -> Spike 2 LEDs [node, index] (several = an RGB insert: lit when any is); numbers from the PRO's led_io.txt (the LE build in the rig ships no LED table); the shots follow the script's CycleStackedLights order, the modes its PlayerMode names; GUESS = placed by position

lamp_calls._: the GI's look (PF_GiOFF and the plastics' GI images, the table's GiOn/GiOff) follows the machine's GI strings (PAD-1093)
